title: Unknown-object cards never show a box (0 of 18 unknowns), and several share one frame, so the operator classifies blind
steps: Open the Unknown objects tab. Look at the cards for frame 063303 (grey object, orange bag, blue container) or frame 063503 (treadmill, grey device, black bag). Click the image to enlarge it.
expected: Each unknown shows its frame with a box around the object it describes, so the operator can see which thing is the 'orange tool' before choosing a catalog item.
actual: Every card says 'Whole frame: there is no box for this object.' The image_bbox is null for all 18 open unknowns at 06:45 UTC. Three cards share frame 063303 and three share frame 063503. The 'orange tool' in COL1 (frame 062808) is not identifiable: there are at least two orange objects in that frame. The orange sphere was only classifiable because it happens to be visually obvious.
suggested_fix: Ground each unknown label to a box before raising the review (OWLv2 or the detector, using the model's label and description as the text query; the planned QUESTIONS #38 next step). Until that exists, hold unknowns with no box and no distinctive description out of the queue, or show the description in the lightbox and an 'I can't tell which object' Dismiss reason.

title: The unknown queue floods (5 -> 18 -> 26 review items in about 15 minutes of tour), with structure and fixed equipment the denylist misses
page: /review?kind=unknown_object, chat 'What changed in the last hour?'
steps: GET /api/review?status=open over time; or ask 'What changed in the last hour?'.
expected: A short list of loose, classifiable items. Station structure and fixed equipment (latches, insulation, wall-mounted cylinders, hatches, covers, the treadmill) do not reach the queue. At most 1-2 unknowns per frame.
actual: There were 5 open unknowns at 06:33, 18 at 06:45, and a badge of 26 at 06:47. They include 'yellow latch: a yellow latch mechanism on the hatch frame', 'silver foil insulation along the floor', 'silver cylinder mounted on the wall', 'white cloth cover on equipment', 'grey object: large smooth grey object in the foreground' (this is the hatch in frame 063303; I marked it Not inventory) and 'treadmill' (fixed exercise equipment in Zvezda). The change list is dominated by these 'New X seen' rows.
suggested_fix: Add 'latch', 'insulation', 'foil', 'treadmill', and qualifiers such as 'mounted on the wall' or 'on the hatch frame', to the structure denylist. Make 'cover' match as a head noun after colour or material words ('white cloth cover'). Hold generic colour+noun labels ('grey object', 'blue container') until they are seen a second time or a box exists. Cap new unknowns per frame (for example 2).

title: Re-identification silently moves a laptop from Kibo to Zvezda: one entity absorbs a different unit in another module, with no move event
steps: Open the laptop 8535788a and read its History. Ask 'Where is the laptop right now?'.
expected: The rack-mounted laptop seen in JPM1 stays in JPM1. A laptop seen in Zvezda 6 minutes later is a new entity, or at most a possible-duplicate review. If a location really changes, a 'moved' event appears in Activity.
actual: The sightings are JPM1 06:28 (0.90), JPM1 06:29, USOS 06:34 (0.90) and ZVEZDA 06:35 (0.50). The hero now shows a Zvezda frame, and Last location is Zvezda. Activity says 'No recorded activity (moves, uses or hand-overs)'. Kibo now has no laptop, and the chat lists two Zvezda laptops.
suggested_fix: For generic catalog classes (laptop, m-bag, CTB, camera), a match across modules needs high embedding similarity plus a plausible camera path. Otherwise create a new entity or a duplicate review. Never update last_location from a 0.50-confidence sighting in another module without emitting a 'moved' event.

title: 'Who was in the Cupola?' gives the wrong person: it counts current location, not sightings, and the one track it lists was filmed in Node 1
steps: Ask 'Who was in the Cupola?' (Q6 of the standard chat). Compare with /items/395bae46-07da-4289-9f11-8fc40b39cd7f (it has a CUP1 sighting at 06:31:08, frame 063108, captioned 'Cupola') and /items/d1c983d2-f272-41e9-8837-d31229b15962 (its only frame, 063138, shows 'To NOD 3' signs and the 'Portable Breathing Apparatus' label, so it is Node 1).
expected: Tracks with a sighting in CUP1 today: the person in the blue shirt and olive trousers filmed in the captioned Cupola frame (and 28513d12, which also has a CUP1 sighting). No track whose only evidence is outside the Cupola.
actual: '1 person track was seen in Cupola (CUP1)… Person (blue shirt, orange helmet)', which is d1c983d2 from the Node 1 frame. 395bae46 and 28513d12, both sighted in CUP1, are left out because their last_location later fell back to USOS. Two further problems: the module carry (45 s) labels Node 1 frames 063133/063138 as CUP1, and the real Cupola sighting is attached to a 'grey long-sleeve shirt' track although the frame shows a blue shirt.
suggested_fix: people_seen with a location should filter on sightings at that location in the window, not on items.last_location; add a sightings query to the API. In the module carry, end the carry when the scene summary names another module, or when a hatch transit or caption change is seen, and shorten carry_s.

title: A later segment-only sighting overwrites a module location: 44% of items end at 'US Orbital Segment'
steps: Open person 28513d12 (NOD1 06:30, CUP1 06:31, then USOS 06:32) or f77dc775 (JPM1, NOD1, then USOS). Look at /api/stats by_location_level.
expected: last_location keeps the most specific recent module. A segment-level sighting soon after a module-level one refines the time, not the place.
actual: All three people in galley frame 063208 dropped to USOS. by_location_level at 06:45 is module 31, segment 24 (44% segment-only). The overview line makes this visible, which fixes UI4-07's reporting gap, but the data quality is unchanged.
suggested_fix: In ingest, do not replace a module last_location with its parent segment within N minutes (for example 3). Store the segment sighting, but keep the module.

title: History sighting frames without a box cannot be enlarged
steps: Open laptop e6f810c9 and click a SIGHTING thumbnail in History.
expected: Every evidence thumbnail opens the Lightbox (with the 'no box' caption when there is none), as the hero and the Activity evidence already do.
actual: Sightings with no bbox render a plain (ItemDetailPage.tsx line 177, Thumb). Clicking it does nothing (no role=dialog appears), so the walkthrough step 'check its frames' only works for the hero.
suggested_fix: Use FrameImage with noBox for every timeline image (lines 173-177), keeping the person placeholder rule.

title: 'show more changes' after other questions goes to the LLM (7.6 s), and on a live list it repeats rows
steps: Ask Q4 'What changed in the last hour?', then Q5-Q7, then 'show more changes'.
expected: An instant code-path page 2 that continues exactly where page 1 ended, even after intervening questions and while new data arrives.
actual: First text arrived at 7.6 s after 'Reading the question' (an LLM round trip), because the harness only checks the last assistant message for a page marker. Page 2 shows '11-20 of 61' (page 1 was 'of 59', window 05:41-06:41 versus 05:42-06:42). As a result, 'black strap' and 'gas cylinder' (rows 9-10 of page 1) appear again as rows 11-12.
suggested_fix: Search back through earlier assistant messages for the latest marker whose list type matches ('changes'). Freeze the window and use a cursor (until = page 1's end time, plus the last event id) instead of a plain offset.

title: Empty answers are terse, and one cites 16 unrelated items
steps: Ask 'Who used the drill?' and, in a new chat, 'What is in the crew quarters?'.
expected: Drill: 'No drill has been seen yet today (catalog: Pistol-grip drill, usually kept in …).' Crew quarters: 'Nothing is on record in the Node 2 crew quarters (private area).' Citations are listed only for the rows the answer shows.
actual: Drill: 'I don't have a record of that.' Crew quarters: 'I do not have a record of any specific items…' followed by 16 citations for unknown objects all over the station (from a list_unknowns call the answer did not use).
suggested_fix: Return citations only for the rows that were rendered. Give no-result answers a template that names what was searched and the catalog fallback.

title: First sightings appear as 'Moved by an unknown person'; people show 'Last handled: Seen moving'
steps: Open the camera 1cb6165e (mounted on a robotic arm), or look at the Last handled column in Inventory.
expected: A first sighting reads 'First seen in US Orbital Segment', with no actor and no 'moved'. For person tracks, Last handled is '—' or 'Arrived in Cupola'.
actual: The event is from_location=null -> USOS, shown as 'Moved by an unknown person to US Orbital Segment (USOS)' in Activity and in Last handled. The Overview row reads 'camera moved to US Orbital Segment'. Person rows show 'Seen moving'.
suggested_fix: Do not emit a 'moved' event when from_location is null (the 'added' event covers it). In LastHandled, show nothing for person self-moves, or 'Arrived in X'.

title: Copy polish: 'no box for this object' on person heroes, 'split' versus 'unmerge', lowercase pipeline labels
steps: Open person 395bae46; open the History of 8c58d341 after a merge and undo; scan the Inventory Item column.
expected: 'Whole frame: several people may be visible' on person heroes (the review card already says this). One verb, 'Unmerged by ui-review-5'. Item labels in sentence case ('Laptop', 'M-bag'), like 'Person: …' and 'Orange ball'.
actual: The person hero says 'there is no box for this object'. The audit says 'split by ui-review-5' while the toast and button say Unmerge. Labels mix 'laptop' and 'm-bag' with 'Person: …' and 'Orange ball'.
suggested_fix: Use the person-aware caption in FrameImage on the detail page, map the audit op 'split' to 'Unmerged', and apply sentence case to labels in the display helper.
